Name: Persona 5 Noir (Haru Okumura) skin for Susan SVE
Author: DawnWander
Description:
解压缩后覆盖 SVE 文档
我只做了简单的测试，如果有任何问题，请在评论区告诉我

苏珊的美化很少，并且我发现苏珊的部分形象可以承载我小小的幻想——小春厌倦了作为公司大老板的生活，隐姓埋名来到了星露谷，追寻她真正喜欢的事物——没错，就是种植！
如果下载的人多，我会考虑做其他服装合并成季节性服饰！

After unzipping the archive,  overwriting the SVE file
I only did a simple test, please let me know in the comment area if you have any questions

Susan has very little mod, and I've found that some of Susan's images can carry my little fantasies - Haru is tired of life as the big boss of the company and comes to Stardew Valley incognito to pursue what she really likes - yes, planting!
If there are many people downloading, I will consider making other costumes and merging them into seasonal costumes!
